rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese word for both the pineapple plant and its fruit.

example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 bo1 lo4 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this mainly when referring to the Taiwan-associated or written term rather than the usual Hong Kong word 菠蘿.

example.english: This Taiwanese pineapple is really sweet.
example.traditional: 呢個台灣鳳梨真係好甜。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 toi4 waan1 fung6 lei4 zan1 hai6 hou2 tim4

rows.note: Use this when you need to specify the pineapple plant rather than the fruit.

example.english: This pineapple plant has borne fruit for the first time this year.
example.traditional: 呢棵菠蘿樹今年第一次結果。
example.jyutping: ni1 fo2 bo1 lo4 syu6 gam1 nin4 dai6 jat1 ci3 git3 gwo2
